translation: Took place in posad Serock, 27 February 1890, 10 AM. Appeared personally Hersz Lew, trader, 28, and Szlama Kuraker[?], house owner, 45, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 5 AM in posad Serock died Boruch Moszko Herszfeld, 50 years of age, son of the late parents Berek and [unclear: Chana], the Herszfeld spouses. He left behind his wife Chana and [unclear: seven] children. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Boruch Moszko Herszfeld this act was signed by us and the witnesses.
